verdict: approve scoped terminal raw-EOS capture with post-run file and pair verification
findings: The 16 arrays are base/accepted projected ph,t,mu, alt,p_pert, plus common mu_base,alb,p_base,c1h,c2h,rdnw. Original dtype and shape and flattened FP64 data byte FNV are emitted. Finite CPU FP32 coefficients convert exactly to FP64.
Exclusive newly created eos_raw directory precedes reuse of existing little-endian NPY writer, with failure on mkdir/write errors; partial files remain evidence if an error interrupts output.

eos_scalars and accepted K/R and fixed context checks execute before raw writing; after writing hash/solver-call counters verify no RHS, JVP or preconditioner call. Existing 1502 accepted-pair capture/equality/JSON hash logic is unchanged; actual cross-run old pair match remains for postvalidation.
Writing, tensor detaches/conversions/allocations, hashing and A5 trial instrumentation consume time/memory and can fail; zero solver calls does not mean zero overhead or continuation parity.
No direct I/O round-trip test added in this revision. Independently verify all 16 native NPY shapes, source dtype metadata, byte lengths and data hashes before use.
boundary: MPFR arithmetic analysis applies only to rounded EOS subroutine inputs/outputs; it does not enclose upstream alb or state formation, full RHS, scaled norm or exact forcing.
validation: source review and git diff --check; no tests, native build, model or RK3 comparison
